correctness.rationale: The proof obtains every homomorphism as affine via displacement translations because 1-T is invertible, derives f^2=f iff L is a commuting projection and a lies in ker L, enumerates all ordered primary-module splittings by Aut(V)/(Aut(U)Aut(W)), proves the automorphism order using End(V) size and its Jacobson-radical unit quotient, and counts each fixed image by Hom(W,U). Boundary dim V≥1 and excluded t,t-1 primary factors are explicit; no finite enumeration is misused as an infinite proof. Direct checker enumerated nine exact small linear cases, three complete fixed-image fiber cases, and two complete small quandle mapping cases.

originality.rationale: The claim is the full nonsemisimple elementary-divisor retraction-image enumeration and per-image multiplicity. The 2010 retraction-to-split-module observation already covers structural existence; existing semisimple retraction profiles are covered and excluded. The inspected 2017, 2021 and 2023 primary work treats affine subquandles, homomorphic images, or good involutions, not the nonsemisimple quantitative formula. No inspected source supplies this formula, but older module-enumeration equivalents remain a material risk.
residual_risks: The connection between Alexander-quandle retractions and split module epimorphisms was explicit already in 2010; only the detailed nonsemisimple multiplicities are independently claimed.
A classical formula for idempotents in finite module endomorphism rings may be algebraically equivalent to the stated count, even if not presented in quandle language.
A 2011 paper on Alexander-quandle automorphism groups was not read in full; its accessible account concerns automorphisms, not exact idempotent-map fibers.
Public literature and indexed searches cannot establish global novelty; an equivalent exact census in older module-combinatorics literature might subsume the calculation.

value.rationale: Complete natural retraction-image invariants for every nonsemisimple connected Alexander quandle of prime-field type, including mixed Jordan lengths and irreducible primary powers, not an unmotivated single instance. Same-cardinality quandles of size nine have different retraction totals (46 for scalar type, 10 for indecomposable Jordan type), and the formula gives per-specified-image multiplicities, full spectrum, and exact indecomposable no-proper-retract criterion. The split-retraction concept and semisimple cases are acknowledged as prior.
